shortDescription: Loopscale said deposit and withdrawal functions for all vaults, as well as all loan management functions, have been restored. According to Foresight News, the Solana-based lending protocol also said it will publish a full technical postmortem soon.

title: Loopscale Restores Deposits, Withdrawals, and All Loan Management Functions
